token.description: A personal access token (`ghost_pat_…`) from Settings, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `Authorization: token <token>`. It acts as the account that created it. A token on a public route acts as its owner; a bad one is refused with 401. Email addresses, SSH, GPG and signing keys, OAuth apps and invitations by username refuse it with 403 and need a signed-in browser session. Tokens issued to OAuth apps carry scopes and work only on the GitHub-compatible API under `/api/v3` and `/api/graphql`. Twenty bad tokens from one address within a minute get 429. Each account gets 120 requests a minute by default, shared by its tokens and sessions; responses carry the GitHub `X-RateLimit-*` headers, and a 429 carries `Retry-After`. `GET /api`, avatar and attachment downloads and the importer callbacks are not counted and carry no such headers, nor does a 401 for a bad token.

webhookActive.description: Turns the webhook off or back on. Turning it on clears the reason Ghost turned it off.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the public key, base64.

privateKey.description: PKCS#1 PEM, shown only now. Ghost keeps only the public half.

lastEight.description: The last 8 characters, to tell secrets apart.

appId.description: The App ID: the JWT `iss`, and `integration_id` in rulesets.

installUrl.description: The web page an owner installs the app from.

permissions.description: What an installation accepts, shown before installing.

repositoryIds.description: Required, and at least one, when the selection is `selected`. Each must be one of the account's repositories.

account.description: Your username, or the slug of an organization you administer.

installationId.description: The id the app passes to `POST /app/installations/{id}/access_tokens`.

permissions.description: What the account accepted. The installation can do no more.

pending.description: What the app asks for now, when that is more than the installation accepted. Null when there is nothing to review.

redirectUrl.description: Where to send the installer next: the app's setup URL with `installation_id` and `setup_action`, or the installed-apps settings.

repositoryIds.description: Required, and at least one, when the selection is `selected`. Each must be one of the account's repositories.
